name: jobtrail
description: JobTrail — job application tracking system (M.Tech DBMS project): React + Express + SQLite

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm install --prefix backend --omit=dev && npm install --prefix frontend --include=dev && npm run build --prefix frontend
